newsitem.title: USA: Southern National looks at name change.
newsitem.headline: Southern National looks at name change.

text.p: WINSTON-SALEM, N.C., March 20 (Reuter) Southern National Corp said Wednesday it will recommend that shareholders approve a change in the name of the holding company to BB&T Corp at its annual meeting, April 22.

The change is recommended to the corporate name only and would not affect any of the company's subsidiaries or lines of businesses. If approved as the new name, BB&T Corporation shares would be listed on the New York Stock Exchange under the trading symbol, BBK.
Bank officials said they wanted to tie the corporate name to the name of the company's banking subsidiaries in Virginia and the Carolinas.
Southern National operates banks in the three states under the BB&T (Branch Banking & Trust Company) name.
